# Native Fragments

> Fast applications. Explicit HTML. Native Fragments streams server-rendered
> routes on Cloudflare Workers, upgrades native navigation, and uses Lit for
> interactive islands.

## Documentation

- [Technical docs](https://docs.nativefragments.org/llms.txt)
- [Getting started](https://docs.nativefragments.org/getting-started.md)
- [Fragment navigation](https://docs.nativefragments.org/fragments.md)
- [Streaming](https://docs.nativefragments.org/streaming.md)
- [Lit components](https://docs.nativefragments.org/components.md)
- [API reference](https://docs.nativefragments.org/reference.md)
